mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without additional triggers.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-pandemic supply recovery, INDPRO above 105.0 index level signals manufacturing output growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is above 105.0 during the post-pandemic recovery phase.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% triggers hawkish policy expectations, reducing equity valuations and predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly payroll growth exceeding 100k (PAYEMS) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through stronger consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) declining more than 5% from prior month signals weakening consumer confidence, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST falls > 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 index level drives positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as manufacturing output supports earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 105.0.
